summary: A shallow rectangular open bamboo tray with straight thin walls, a flat closed floor, and one centered white projecting grip on the long front wall.

No measurements or known metric reference were supplied. Dimensions are uncalibrated nominal estimates based on proportions and object-size priors, not a metric scan.
The object is represented as one rigid assembly. No articulation or internal mechanism is inferred.
Materials use approximate flat PBR colors. Lighting is not calibrated and image textures are not recovered.
Mass and friction are simulation assumptions; these are not determined by the visible video dynamics.
Nominal wooden tray is 280 x 160 x 60 mm. The white handle projects approximately 24 mm beyond the front face; all sizes are uncalibrated.
The white grip is treated as a fixed solid rounded pull lip. Underside details and any hidden mounting clearance are not resolved; no through-loop is established by the video.
The floor and four walls are separate convex colliders, preserving the entire open interior.
Wood grain, laminate strips and joints are not recovered as image textures. The flat floor and underside thickness are inferred.
Nominal mass is assumed to be 0.35 kg; friction 0.5 and restitution 0 are assumptions.
Second candidate was refined by comparing renders to video crops; no calibrated image registration or metric accuracy score is claimed.
